NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.title: Naraku
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.IN: Ninja Slayer tosses and turns beneath the blanket of his own mind.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.CA: Fuyuko and Tochinoki cry out from somewhere close within the smoke. Fujikido reaches for them and finds only a sharper nightmare.
The same Christmas night burns again. Naraku fans the pain into black flame and waits for Fujikido to surrender his body.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.AC: His wife and son vanish into the flames once more. Naraku chuckles in the depths of his neurons: surrender the body, and the vengeance may continue.
Fujikido loosens his grip on the reins of self. Red-black flame floods his body, and Naraku's laughter merges with his breath.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_NARAKU_EVENT.pages.SI: "Silence, Naraku." Fujikido speaks his own name and rises from the nightmare on a deep, Chado-like breath.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_DARK_NINJA_EVENT.page: The dark cloak stands in the stone chamber. Empty! Killing intent strikes from behind. "Domo, Ninja Slayer-san. Dark Ninja desu." "Domo, Dark Ninja-san. Ninja Slayer desu." A shuriken pierces the cloak. GOURANGA! The true body already waits at Ninja Slayer's landing point! Death Slash closes in!
Dark Ninja withdraws Death Slash and assumes an iaijutsu stance. The killing intent in the chamber becomes tangible.
Ninja Slayer evades Death Slash and withdraws from the chamber. Among Kyoto Castle's debris, he finds 100 Gold.
Dark Ninja's temporary body dissolves into zeroes and ones from the wound. Blade, cloak, and cold smile vanish in turn, all reclaimed by Kyoto Castle's circuitry deep within the stone walls.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_SAWATARI_EVENT.title: The Moving Jungle
A bamboo spear punches through a supply crate and grazes Ninja Slayer's menpo! A tripwire snaps taut at the same instant. Beyond the poisonous vines, Sawatari raises his gun. "Domo, Ninja Slayer-san. Forest Sawatari desu." "Domo, Forest Sawatari-san. Ninja Slayer desu." Clawed feet scrape beyond the door. "Kill them first. The duel can wait."

Sawatari presses the detonator. Poisonous vines and spikes seal the doorway, bunching the creatures together. The two ninjas strike from opposite sides. When the last monster falls, the entire room begins to move, and their temporary truce ends with it.
Take the normal combat rewards and leave.
Forfeit the normal combat rewards and duel Forest Sawatari.

Bamboo spear and red-black karate chop collide again and again. Sawatari uses the final impact to vault into a smoke screen and vanish along a prepared escape route. Ninja Slayer does not pursue. Their two clashes have already stripped the wasted motion from his attacks.
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YUKANO_EVENT.title: The Crooked Torii
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YUKANO_EVENT.pages.IN: A crooked torii blocks the passage, and running water sounds beyond it. When Ninja Slayer reaches out, Yukano stops his wrist with her wooden staff. ‘Wait. The presence inside is changing.’ Silver Key crouches at the lock and grips his silver key. ‘This door will open. I just cannot promise where it leads.’
Let Silver Key open the way
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YUKANO_EVENT.pages.SI: The silver key turns. A narrow path appears beyond the torii, lined with several red-black afterimages. Silver Key braces the doorway. ‘Do not look at them. Go! This door will not hold much longer.’
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YUKANO_EVENT.pages.YU: Yukano lays her wooden staff across the torii. A ward pins the shaking frame in place. ‘Silver Key-san, find the exit. Ninja Slayer-san, I will travel with you for a while.’
NINJA_SLAYER_EVENT_YAMOTO_KOKI_CUTE_EVEN: Yamoto Koki temporarily joins your party!
Yamoto Koki runs away crying after being robbed!
